nodes.label: Concept Store
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 centers on saving reusable internal concepts to reduce duplicate learning tree generation across topics.

nodes.label: Concept REST API
nodes.rationale: The plan defines concept list, detail, patch, edge, and tree reference endpoints for developer and admin workflows.

nodes.label: Concept Edges
nodes.rationale: Edges encode prerequisite, used_by, related, part_of, and other relationships between reusable concepts.

nodes.label: Learning Tree Concepts
nodes.rationale: The mapping records which learning trees use a concept and its role in each tree.

nodes.label: User Concept Progress
nodes.rationale: Progress stored at concept level lets known concepts carry across trees and informs recommendations.

nodes.label: Concept Reuse Indicators
nodes.rationale: Tree UI needs badges and labels showing whether a concept is new, reused, or already known.

nodes.label: Concept Detail Panel
nodes.rationale: Node clicks expose context, explanations, related concepts, prerequisites, and other tree usages without turning the product into a wiki.

nodes.label: Admin Concepts Screen
nodes.rationale: A lightweight internal route accelerates debugging of concept lists, details, edges, tree usage, and merge candidates.

nodes.label: Concept Merge Candidates
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous duplicate concepts are recorded for status-based review instead of automatic unsafe merges.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Smoke Verification
nodes.rationale: Smoke tests validate schema, resolution, persistence, reuse, API payloads, progress, and explanation reuse without external LLM calls.

nodes.label: Tree View
nodes.rationale: Phase 2.5 changes the default result screen into a root-topic-centered learning path rather than a sectioned card list.

nodes.label: Top-Down Prerequisite Decomposition
nodes.rationale: The visual tree keeps parent concept to direct prerequisite children direction and avoids reversing prerequisite edges.

nodes.label: Tree View Interactions
nodes.rationale: Zoom, pan, center, modal detail, keyboard focus, and status select behavior make large trees usable.

nodes.label: Tree Generation Latency Instrumentation
nodes.rationale: Generation latency must be split into LLM, parsing, persistence, concept reuse, and response costs before optimization.

nodes.label: Perceived Performance Wait UI
nodes.rationale: Elapsed time and step labels reduce the chance users interpret long synchronous generation as a frozen UI.

nodes.label: Document Storage Schema
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 needs documents, pages, chunks, document concepts, and document-tree links to persist uploaded source material.

nodes.label: Document Concepts
nodes.rationale: This table preserves extracted or inferred concept metadata, evidence, and optional linkage to Phase 2 concepts.

nodes.label: Document Upload API
nodes.rationale: The upload endpoint accepts PDF, TXT, and MD files, validates limits, and creates uploaded document records.

nodes.label: Text Extraction
nodes.rationale: Uploaded documents must be converted into page text before chunking or LLM concept extraction can run.

nodes.label: Chunking
nodes.rationale: Documents are split by section, page, paragraph, and token limits into 800 to 1500 token analysis units.

nodes.label: Document LLM Schemas
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 defines validated JSON schemas for chunk extraction, document integration, document tree generation, and node explanations.

nodes.label: Document Based Learning Tree
nodes.rationale: Document concepts and inferred prerequisites are transformed into a learning tree with evidence-aware nodes.

nodes.label: Source Type
nodes.rationale: explicit, inferred, and generated source types distinguish direct document evidence from AI-inferred prerequisites or generated explanations.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.rationale: Evidence stores document, chunk, page, section, and snippet references for explicit concepts.

nodes.label: Document Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The process endpoint orchestrates upload verification, text extraction, chunking, concept extraction, concept matching, and tree creation.

nodes.label: Document Concept Resolution
nodes.rationale: Extracted document concepts are normalized, matched against the Concept Store, or persisted as new reusable concepts.

nodes.label: Document Query APIs
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 exposes document metadata, concepts, document tree, and evidence through ownership-checked query endpoints.

nodes.label: Document Upload Result UI
nodes.rationale: The UI guides users through file upload, processing status, extracted concepts, inferred prerequisites, and navigation to the generated tree.

nodes.label: Document Tree UI
nodes.rationale: Existing tree rendering is extended with document source type, evidence, and document-aware detail fields.

nodes.label: Document Recommendation Logic
nodes.rationale: Document recommendations prioritize unknown inferred prerequisites, explicit prerequisites, important core concepts, misconceptions, and quiz nodes.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Quality Verification
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 quality checks cover upload, extraction, chunking, concept integration, concept store matching, tree creation, evidence, and document-context detail.
